name: linkedin-profile-resume-sync
description: Use an agent-authored session plan to discover, create, update, and verify LinkedIn resume sections through visible browser forms.

interface.shortDescription: 由 Agent 完成 LinkedIn 履歷
interface.longDescription: Connects Codex to visible LinkedIn forms. The Agent discovers each form, builds a session plan from requested resume changes, previews visible before/after values, creates or updates only reviewed mapped sections, verifies saved values, and exports local audit snapshots without undocumented LinkedIn APIs.
interface.defaultPrompt: 使用 Resume Contract Studio 探索我的 LinkedIn 可見頁面，依照我提供的履歷內容新增或修改完整履歷，逐項核對後匯出本機紀錄。
